notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 4th-of-July sheet lists Kuna, 208-922-5546, with June 3 call notes saying NO, CALL NEXT YEAR. Gmail clarifies the established event relationship is Kuna Days, including a prior inbound quote request and budget concerns. Preserve the call-next-year instruction without inventing a due date. Source: handwritten call notes, page 88; Adventure Zone Gmail.
